messages:
jessica: Hey folks — PR is updated with the requested changes and unit tests fixed. Link: https://git/repo/pulls/412. Can I get two quick eyes? I left a short note on the changelog and added a smoke script.

raj: taking a look now. quick q — did you keep the batching default the same? want to avoid perf surprises.

jessica: @raj I left the default intact; added a new flag `--enable-new-batching` behind a feature toggle. perf tests show ~2% variance in p50 locally.

maria: thanks. CI looks flaky on windows job last run, but linux passed. @ci-bot can you re-run windows?

ci-bot: windows-extended job requeued by @maria. Current status: running. (reacted with :repeat:)

alex: glanced at the diff — code looks good. one nit: update the inline comment in runtime/allocator.go to mention why rotation is safe with the toggle. other than that, LGTM from me.

raj: noted the toggle. left one small comment about error handling in the fast path, PTAL.

jessica: addressed both comments (removed the redundant nil check and expanded the comment). also added the smoke script to tools/smoke/batching_check.sh:
```
#!/bin/bash
# quick smoke to ensure no regressions
python -m perf_runner --target localhost:8080 --seq 128
```

jessica: CI passed (all green). Who's able to give the second LGTM? I can squash and queue for canary after two approvals.

maria: i can give the second LGTM if windows job is green. planning to schedule the canary at 10:15 PT. is that okay?

alex: windows job just finished and looks good. i'm happy to be second LGTM, but @maria please confirm canary slot.

maria: confirmed 10:15 PT works. one more ask: please add a short note in the release notes about the toggle and how to enable it for Dedicated customers.

jessica: done — added the release note under docs/release/notes.md and linked it in the PR description. squashing now and will mark ready to merge once you both ack.

raj: ack from me after verifying the error-handling comment. :thumbsup:

alex: ack. :ship:
